interpretation: Admissions and refusals are actual local API results under simulated identities and declared economic inputs.
Signed fixture attestations confirm recorded statements, not independent capability truth or correct market forecasts.
Public deterministic encryption/signing keys provide no production privacy or identity assurance.
The source-job A cost remains unspecified; the fixed recipient panel charges only incremental B and optional C.
The zero declared uncertainty margin is not a confidence guarantee; successful future revalidation is an assumption.
Every direct-label fixture member can retrieve an admitted bundle, even without execution action permissions.
Members may copy exported public fixture capsules; access control is not demonstrated defensibility.
The two cases use separate graphs and represent alternative modeled decisions, not two actual invention campaigns.
The recipient candidate's admitted label is only a cost-model eligibility assumption; this replay starts graph candidates and cannot import that label as admission.
No full customer outcome, executable invention, cash payment, or realized reinvestment loop is established here.
